training.loss: Response-only LM loss; six balanced training classes; no rule outputs as model input

export.quantization: Q8_0 group64 matmul weights; RMSNorm/RoPE/softmax/SwiGLU stay FP32

split.split_policy: SHA256 of exact model prompt group, all splits pairwise disjoint; test excludes old training prompts and historical evaluation prompts
split.constant_classes: Only two canonical patterns exist; trained anchors and regression checks, excluded from unseen-prompt accuracy
split.unknown_definition: Insufficient periodic evidence, one/two pulses; no contradiction with known periodic classes

limits: Synthetic periodic-signal operating domain, not external physical accuracy
STUCK_HIGH and STUCK_LOW are the only two canonical constant prompts; separately tested, not unseen-class generalization
Unknown class restricted to insufficient periodic evidence, not arbitrary OOD rejection
No calibrated confidence or blanket safety certification
Locked test evaluated after validation-only checkpoint selection; historical test is a regression, not a blind test
